summary: Cable One filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a mutual extension of the closing date for its previously announced purchase of the remaining equity interests in Mega Broadband Investments Holdings LLC (MBI) from GTCR affiliates. Per the January 3, 2026 Purchase Agreement, closing was pushed from October 1 to October 9, 2026, or earlier if mutually agreed. Cable One also disclosed that financing discussions with potential investors concluded. No price per share, premium, or advisor was stated. Watch regulatory clearance and financing certainty ahead of the October 9 deadline.
